selection.bestVersion: Highest rating as the game shows it; ties: the higher EA overall, then the latest edition
selection.legends: Best versions shown 85+: players who are not in the catalog, and catalog players whose current card shows less; of a catalog nation; the club of that edition when it is in the catalog
selection.primes: Catalog players whose best version shows 2+ more than their current card, or 88+ and more than now
selection.year: The year of the ratings snapshot (fifa_update_date)
selection.composure: FIFA 15/16 have no composure: taken from the nearest later edition, else reactions
